newsitem.title: USA: ENStar Inc expects a loss in Q1 Mar 31.
newsitem.headline: ENStar Inc expects a loss in Q1 Mar 31.

text.p: ENStar Inc said Monday it expects to report a loss for the first quarter ending March 31 because of a drop in the demand for its connectivity products.

Demand for products made by its Americable and Transition Networks units has declined in the first two months of the period, ENStar said, resulting in an estimated pre-tax operating loss of more than $1.4 million in the quarter.
ENStar reported earnings of $19,000, or $0.01 a share, in the fourth quarter of 1996, compared to $522,000, or $0.16 a share in the final quarter of 1995.
A spokesman said ENStar is expected to report full first-quarter results near the end of April.
ENStar provides networking devices and services.
